title: An imported work order's lead technician cannot be changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • View: on Work Orders the List is shown (click List in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar; its tooltip reads "List").
  • An Imported work order exists at this location (Imported work orders come only from an invoice import; to make one: Settings > Invoices (in the IMPORTS group): click Download Template, fill one row in the template (keep its heading row; the columns marked * are required; Shop Location = this location's name, a customer name, an Invoice Number such as ZZIMP-1001, Invoice Date as month/day/year e.g. 10/01/2026, Item Labor, a Line Title, Qty 1, Rate 100, Total 100, Tax Amount 5), save it as a .csv file, click Select CSV File, pick the file and click Import Invoices; the message reads "All invoices have been imported successfully." The imported work order's number is the Invoice Number you typed, and it is listed only when Status > Imported is ticked).

Setup

  1. Work Orders > List > All tab > Status > tick Imported only.
  2. Check the setup worked: at least one work order is listed. If none is listed, make one with the invoice import above, then tick Imported again.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders in List, click All, tick Imported in Status and open the work order.
  2. Write down Lead Technician.
  3. Try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Lead Technician cannot be changed (it is shown disabled, or the change is refused with a message).
  • Step 4: Lead Technician reads the same as at step 2.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): opening an imported work order goes to a separate imported page showing the number, "Imported", "Invoiced: <date>", Financial Info and the invoice, with no Lead Technician shown at all, so there is nothing to write down at step 2 or change at step 3. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Low; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), What is NOT Impacted; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (S4-N2). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply Low: “Imported work orders: they open in List, and the lead stays locked.”
  • PRD S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
